title: Standing Firm in Spiritual Warfare
description: In this powerful sermon, Pastor Chris Zehner shares a personal testimony of spiritual warfare and the importance of standing firm in faith, even in the midst of intense physical and emotional attacks. Listen as Pastor Zehner recounts his own experience of being taken to the brink of collapse, but rising up in worship and faith to see God's miraculous intervention. This is a must-listen for anyone who has ever faced spiritual battles and needs to be encouraged to stand strong in their faith.
